title: Iron Production Among the Haya
description: The Haya of northwestern Tanzania achieved furnace temperatures rivaling early European blast furnaces roughly 1,500-2,000 years earlier, using preheated-air forced-draft furnaces.

title: The Stone Construction Techniques of Great Zimbabwe
description: How Great Zimbabwe's builders achieved structurally sound mortarless dry-stone walls at scale, and what the coursing/selection of granite blocks reveals about their engineering knowledge.

title: The Water Engineering of the Kingdom of Kush
description: Kushite hafirs (large artificial reservoirs) and irrigation systems that sustained cities in a semi-arid environment.
